findings: Fresh Buffer Insights snapshot 2026-10-20T10:11:08Z (complete, 108 tracked video posts) reviewed before selecting this topic.
Repo and tool items still carry the reach: the top videos of the last week are single-tool explainers with one visible demo, not round-ups.

Workflow-first beats another capture-page-only film because the product's whole value is a change in how you brief an agent; the film shows the two keystrokes and the output rather than describing the repo.

decisions.topic: 588 stars on day three for a macOS capture tool; the viewer job (stop describing your screen to an agent, hand it a contact sheet instead) is concrete and demoable in ten seconds.
decisions.script: Workflow archetype: hook shows the demo line 'Show an agent the problem', then two keystrokes, then the frames-on-change proof scroll, then the platform catch, then the comment CTA. 148 spoken words for a 52-56 second cut.
decisions.voice: Approved Chatterbox Option-3 flow voice at the fixed floors: at least 92% per chunk and 95% overall.
decisions.visual: Four own browser captures of scrawl.kitlangton.com (hero, How it works, Controls, Install) plus the full-page capture for scroll moves; no marketing media exists on the page, and the catch states the platform limits plainly. Covers designed in cover_lab from three distinct real captures.
